evidence_items.text:
- By 2023-05-01, had finally opened his own car maintenance shop — called it a dream come true; "so satisfying to have a spot to work on cars"; it was a lot of hard work, but it was worth it [S4T1][S4T3].
- Shared a photo of the shop (a car dealership with cars parked in front) [S4T1].
- Opening the shop was his dream and is a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars [S4T3][S4T5].
- Calvin congratulated him, said his hard work and dedication paid off, praised his "guts and ambition", and told him to keep it up [S4T2][S4T4].
- Called opening the shop a "labor of love" — challenging, but "so worth it"; feeling the hard work pay off is "like bringing something back to life" (echoing his car-restoration sentiment), and he finds it incredible that his skills and hard work made it happen [S4T9][S4T11][S4T13].
- Says the "perfect blend of dedication and passion" keeps him motivated and makes it all worthwhile; Calvin encouraged him to "keep going for it!" [S4T14][S4T15][S4T16].
- Shared a second photo of the shop (a group of people standing in front of a car) and invited Calvin to come by sometime [S4T17].
- Works on all kinds of cars at the shop — from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars — which "keeps [him] busy and happy" [S4T18][S4T19].
- Working on cars is what he's passionate about: doing it every day is "so rewarding", "seeing the transformation is awesome", and he finds it satisfying to help people keep their cars in good condition [S4T21].
- Appreciates Calvin's encouragement: "It means a lot that my work is valued and that it brings joy to others" [S4T23].

- On 2023-05-01, said he'd love to check Dave's shop out sometime and asked what sort of cars he works on (Dave: all kinds, from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars) [S4T17][S4T18][S4T19].
- The 2023-05-01 conversation closed with Calvin praising Dave's work ("Keep up the great work!" / "Keep on keepin' on, bud!") after Dave said his work is valued and brings joy to others; Calvin then shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant (see ## Jewelry) [S4T22][S4T23][S4T24].
- On 2023-05-03, reconnected with Dave ("long time no talk") and congratulated him on teaming up with a local garage — "super inspiring seeing [Dave] follow [his] passion", "congratulations on this new venture", "impressive how far [Dave has] come since [they] last chatted"; called the car Dave was working on "awesome" with "a lot of effort" behind it, asked about his plans for next, cheered on Dave's dream of building a custom car ("sounds awesome"), and told him to relax and enjoy the process; when Dave asked how he unwinds, said long drives in his red sports car help him relax (details in ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26) and /memories/dave.md) [S5T1][S5T2][S5T3][S5T4][S5T6][S5T7][S5T8].
- The 2023-05-03 conversation ended with Calvin thanking Dave for the creativity advice ("taking a break is great for getting my mojo back"), saying he won't give up, and "let's stay in touch"; Dave encouraged him to keep pursuing his music and said Calvin can reach out anytime if he needs help [S5T12][S5T13][S5T14][S5T15].
- On 2023-05-16, reconnected with Dave ("long time no chat") and told him the flood had been tough but that he's staying positive; shared his studio photo, asked Dave what exciting projects he's working on, and Dave excitedly told him about the shop's celebration — the two wished each other well (Calvin: "Can't wait to get back to making music") [S6T1][S6T3][S6T5][S6T6][S6T7][S6T8].

- On 2023-05-01, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see") and announced that he had finally opened his own car maintenance shop — a dream come true and a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars; shared a photo of the shop (including a group of people in front of a car) and of the engine of the classic car he restored in 2022, and invited Calvin to come by; Calvin congratulated him, the conversation closed with mutual encouragement, and Calvin shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant (details in ## Car maintenance shop, ## Classic cars, and /memories/calvin.md) [S4T1][S4T5][S4T7][S4T15][S4T16][S4T17][S4T22][S4T23][S4T24].
- On 2023-05-01, complimented Calvin's necklace and asked where he got it (Calvin: a gift from another artist, a reminder of why he keeps hustling as a musician); encouraged Calvin to keep pushing and making music, and the two agreed to keep each other motivated — "the road can be hard, but when we remember why we're doing it, it keeps us going" (in Calvin's words) [S4T25][S4T26][S4T27][S4T28].
- On 2023-05-03, reconnected with Calvin ("long time no talk") and announced the team-up with the local garage; Calvin congratulated him on "this new venture", called it "super inspiring" and "impressive how far [Dave has] come since [they] last chatted", asked about his plans for next, and encouraged him not to forget to relax and enjoy the process; the two also swapped how they unwind — Calvin: long drives in his red sports car (details in ## Car maintenance shop, ## Classic cars, and /memories/calvin.md) [S5T1][S5T2][S5T3][S5T4][S5T6][S5T7][S5T8].
- Later in the 2023-05-03 conversation: agreed with Calvin that driving with the wind in your hair, and walking around to explore the sights and sounds of nature, are calming [S5T9]; when Calvin said his music is stuck ("creativity's frozen"), gave him the creative-block tip (see ## Music) and encouraged Calvin to keep pursuing his music and never give up [S5T10][S5T11][S5T13]; the two said goodbye and agreed to keep in touch, with Dave saying Calvin can let him know if he ever needs help [S5T14][S5T15].
- On 2023-05-16, reconnected with Calvin ("long time no chat"); when Calvin shared that his place had flooded, Dave expressed sympathy, said the saved music gear and mic were "the important things", told Calvin to stay positive, and offered to help [S6T3][S6T4]; Dave praised Calvin's home music studio photo — "That studio looks awesome" — and said he hopes Calvin gets it fixed soon so he can keep creating [S6T5][S6T6]; when Calvin asked what he's working on, Dave excitedly told him about the shop's opening celebration (details in ## Car maintenance shop), and Calvin said he can't wait to get back to making music [S6T7][S6T8].
